lines: The battle with Onigumo Saburo had reached its climax.
With a metallic roar, the giant spider's deadly claws swung down.
ーAce Katana Style: Blade Dance of Divinity!!
Her sword shimmered with divine energy.
It didn't just block the vicious claws, dripping with powerful poison, it repelled them in an instantー
Due to the heavy blow, the giant spider crashed into the wall, and the impact threw Saburo, who was riding on its back, down to the ground.
Countless Shadows appeared in order to block his way, butー
...I'm sorry, but I don't have time to entertain small fries.
The Shadows were cut down one by one, while Shonosuke didn't do anything.
ーNo, it wasn't that he didn't do anything.
Shonosuke was a practitioner of Ninja Art: Falcon Jutsu, specially enhancing his arms.
As he had passed by them, he had unleashed his dual-wielding Iaijutsu with godlike speed and cut down all of the Shadows.
The girl, who had been trying to get back on her feet, swayed and then collapsed to the ground with a thud.
Shonosuke had drawn his sword and struck her with the back, too quickly to be seen with the naked eye.
There hadn't even been time for me to support them with my commands.
She was an excellent Beast Art user who had inherited the name "Onigumo Saburo" at a tender age, but she was being controlled.
It seemed she had stood little chance against the two Taimanin swordsmen, Shishigami Jisai and Gaku Shonosuke.
("It's going to be far harder than killing her," huh... Turns out I had nothing to worry about with those two.)
Yes, I have rendered her unconscious for the moment. With that she should come back to her senses soonー
As soon as Saburo had fainted, the giant spider also suddenly quieted down.
Like Shonosuke had said, it should have been the end of the matter, but...
ーIt's not over yet!!! Don't let your guard down, you two!!
There was a tremble in the air of the underground passage.
The soul-shattering howl of an apparition reverberated, drowning out my shouted warning.

Shonosuke: Ugh!?
Jisai: More Shadows!? And Will-o'-wisps!?
Noticing that Saburo, who they had been assigned to guard, had been defeated,
Will-o'-wisps and Shadows appeared everywhere in the passage, in a last-ditch attack from the magical trap.
This is dangerous! We can't deal with that many...!
Then let's get out of here!! The exit is already open, so both of you, run!!!
Shonosuke gathered up the unconscious Saburo.
And led by Shishigami with her tachi at the ready, we ran through the monster-filled passage towards the exit.
...Shishigami? Um... we broke out of the magical trap... didn't we?
I had woken up outside the black market broker's store.
At the end I was too busy running toward the exit... Come to think of it, you really helped me out a lot.
Every time I had been about to be caught by the Shadows, Shishigami had driven them away.
It was nothing special. I mean, we only made it out of the trap thanks to you, Fuma.
I guess we helped each other.
I nodded with a smileーand then noticed that Shonosuke and Saburo were gone.
Hmm? Where are Shonosuke and Saburo?
Before you woke up, he took the girl and went somewhere. He said, "Let us meet again at the far edge of fate."
Right. Hmm...? Well, Shonosuke has always loved to act all mysterious.
It seemed that he and Saburo were safe, so there was nothing to be concerned about.
So what are you going to do now, Fuma?
Well... I'm done with what I came to do...
I pulled out the item that I had stuffed in my pocket and checked it.
It was the Devildom-produced material for experiments that Kiryu-sensei had sent me on the errand to retrieve.
The store owner he had been doing business with had died, so I had "reluctantly" taken it off the shelf.
Nothing special. More importantly, Shishigami, aren't you hungry?
Oh! I am. Starving to be honest...
I know, right. I mean we were stuck in that dreadful place since morning...
I've got some money left over, so do you want to grab a bite to eat? I'll pay for it.
Really!? I'm in, I'm in! Let's go!!
Wow, you sure jumped at that offer.
Because I'm starving... Besides, you said you would pay!
What should I eat~? Go all out and get a steak...? Ah, but... that Italian place on the west side is hard to disregard...
Hey, hey!? It can't be anything too expensive!?
What are you talking about? I saved your life, didn't I?
We were just saying that we helped each other, right!?
Shishigami and I walked toward the downtown area while quarreling with each other.
Today had been a really crazy dayーbut I had made a new friend, so I guess it wasn't all bad.
Tokyo Kingdom, in a district under control of the Fuma Ninja Forcesー
If he's... if he's really alive, dispose of him. Can you do that?
...Leave it to me, Master. I, Gaku Shonosuke, will give it my all.
Shonosuke bowed quietly and turned to leave the room.
After hesitating for a moment, Gaiza stopped him.
That guy... he's always irritating me. Always...
Gaiza didn't respond to the puzzled Shonosuke.
He just sank deep into his own thoughtsー
(I've cut off everything for the Fuma Clan... I even killed him...)
But was that really the case?
(I couldn't kill my honorable mother... Even though I knew very well that if I didn't kill her, anguish was sure to follow...)
(Did he come back to life as the result of my weaknessー?)
...Shonosuke. This is my and his fate.
If he gets in my way again, I'll take care of it myself. No matter how many times it takes, with my own handsー
The last of his words faded away as if he was talking to himself.
Then... I should leave Kotaro-sama alone?
For now, yes. Instead, I have another mission for you.
Saburo did not contact me as scheduled. I'm sure she's fine, but find her just in case.
Shonosuke bowed to his deeply troubled master and left the room.
